en.headline: Research Grants Council hosts free AI lectures at Science Museum today
en.dek: Two Cantonese sessions on fact-checking and sports education run from 2:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. with free first-come seating.
body: The Research Grants Council and the Hong Kong Science Museum will hold two free public lectures this afternoon on artificial intelligence applications.
The first session, from 2:30 p.m. to 3:30 p.m., features Professor Yupeng Li of Hong Kong Baptist University on using societal AI for automated fact-checking against misinformation.
The second, from 3:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m., has Professor Sau-ching Amy Ha of the Education University of Hong Kong on AI tools for assessing skills and fitness in physical education.

The organisers said the lectures are conducted in Cantonese at the museum’s first-floor lecture hall. Admission is free and first come, first served. A live stream will also be available on the museum’s YouTube channel.

zh.headline: 研資局與科學館今午舉辦免費人工智能公眾講座
zh.dek: 兩場粵語講座分別談事實查核及體育教學，下午二時半至四時半於尖沙咀舉行，免費入場先到先得。
body: 研究資助局與香港科學館今午將舉行兩場免費公眾講座，介紹人工智能的應用。
首場由香港浸會大學李鈺鵬教授主講，題為建立數碼信任，探討以面向社會的人工智能進行自動化事實查核，對抗不實資訊，時間為下午二時半至三時半。
第二場由香港教育大學夏秀禎教授主講，從身體出發，介紹科技及人工智能如何改善體育運動的教與學，時間為下午三時半至四時半。
主辦單位表示，講座以粵語進行，地點為科學館一樓演講廳。免費入場，座位先到先得。市民亦可透過科學館YouTube頻道收看現場直播。
